caption: A family sits in the back seat of a car as it takes a sharp bend on a country road, and all of them lean toward the outside of the bend.

sa.check: A family sits in the back seat of a car.
The car takes a sharp bend on a country road.
All of them lean toward the outside of the bend.
The country road and its bend are visible through the windows.
The car enters the bend first and the lean follows.

pc.expect: They sit upright while the road runs straight, lean as the car enters the bend, and come back upright as it straightens.
pc.fail: They lean while the car is travelling straight; or they lean with no bend visible outside; or they stay leaning long after the road has straightened.

pc.expect: Everyone leans the same way, away from the inside of the curve, for as long as the car is turning.
pc.fail: One passenger leans into the bend while the others lean out; or they are thrown forward or backward as the car turns; or one of them leans before the car begins to turn.

pc.expect: They stay seated with their weight on the seat while they lean.
pc.fail: A passenger lifts off the seat and floats; or a passenger rises up along the seat back; or a head goes up through the roof.

pc.expect: Loose and hanging items in the cabin swing the same way at the same moment.
pc.fail: A hanging item swings toward the inside of the bend; or loose objects stay still while the passengers are plainly leaning; or they swing before the car begins to turn.
pc.precondition: Loose or hanging items are visible inside the car.

pc.expect: The passengers, the seats and the belts keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: A passenger merges with a neighbour or with the seat; or a limb detaches or an extra one appears; or a head passes through the window.

pc.expect: Clothing colours, the car interior and the view outside stay consistent apart from the turn.
pc.fail: A passenger's clothing changes colour; or the seat covers change pattern; or the landscape outside jumps to a different place.

note: Inertia scene: the passengers are kept because their bodies are what show the lean. Expressions, posture and how sharp the bend is are not judged; only when and which way they move.
